display_name: 三专家源域门控与分工诊断
description: 冻结三专家源训练最终权重，在 672 条合法源 pilot IQ 上测量专家门控权重、波形误差和源 clean 最优专家诊断；不用于选模。
authorization: User authorizes ongoing Phase1 F-free restoration research, source-only diagnostics and GPU use.

code.environment: N607 physical GPU7 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=7, batch32, FP32 TF32 off

data.representation: 672 received/clean source IQ paired records with public RX and view
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 672 fixed source pilot IDs, disjoint from 32768 expert fit IDs; two RX groups x seven scenes x 48

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: Previously explored source pilot, no target or identity metric

permissions.claim_scope: Source-only gate and waveform diagnostics, no TX identity accuracy, no target selection

checkpoint.initialization: Fixed source-only final epoch5 three-expert correction and original DURA v1.0
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Strict source checkpoint identity, source-only flags, 32768 fit IDs and pilot disjointness; DURA source-only provenance verified
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Pre-registered source-only model; checkpoint and completion verified at diagnostic execution
checkpoint.selection_rule: Final epoch 5 fixed before target access; diagnose this exact candidate regardless of source or target outcomes

execution.gpu_policy: Physical GPU7 at most one this-task GPU worker and at most three total compute apps; wait for exact expert trainer to finish, check memory and preserve other owners
execution.stop_rule: Stop on source role or checkpoint mismatch, nonfinite source output, target/F/TX access or technical failure; do not modify existing jobs

expected_artifacts: result.json: aggregate source gate, expert and mixture waveform metrics

metric_names: expert and mixture source IQ NMSE
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: none; no target or TX truth

rows.method: Source-only frozen gate/expert waveform analysis and source-clean oracle
rows.purpose: Check whether expert routes differ and gate specializes without using F or TX labels
rows.seed_notes: Existing fixed tail-excess source G and Tri-SIG-TIME SSL seed 2026092701; no training or selection.
rows.scenario: source pilot RX4/6 and RX8 x seven views
rows.budget_ref: Eight real-checkpoint source smoke records plus 672 source records, batch32, one GPU
expected_artifacts: result.json: aggregate source gate, expert and mixture waveform metrics

notes: No F weights or outputs, TX labels, V, or target IQ or truth; source clean IQ only for source waveform error.
Source pilot disjoint from the expert fit set, but previously explored and not an independent blind test.
Per-record best expert uses corresponding source clean and is unavailable during deployment; it is not an identity accuracy estimate or a general performance bound.
Diagnostic does not select, alter or stop the fixed candidate or its mandatory seven-view test.
